data.body:
FIX (design decisions): deterministic, fail-closed, pre-LLM, on the close path — the point the ticket names as the rejection point since the verifier must keep trusting the tag (ADR-0043).

- New pure detector src/rebar/llm/plan_review/det_attestation_launder.py: laundering_gaps() fires per [operator-attested] AC item whose own block (checkbox line + indented continuation lines, bounded by the next checkbox or the AC section end) cites exact repo path/symbol evidence. Precision-first matchers: repo-root-anchored paths (src|tests|docs|scripts/...), slash paths with a code extension incl. pytest ::node ids, bare test_* symbols; URLs scrubbed first. Commit hashes and Gerrit change numbers deliberately do NOT fire — they are the attestation-EVENT provenance ADR-0043's contract itself demands (this is what keeps AC-4's legitimate escape hatch working).
- New close guard txn.ensure_attested_items_valid, wired into close_precheck._completion_precheck right after ensure_ac_boxes_checked: (a) laundering → block with untag/split remedy (reported FIRST so the author is never coached into decorating a mistag with provenance); (b) missing/incomplete provenance: line → block (det_measurement_provenance.provenance_gaps promoted to blocking on the close path only; review-side P6 stays advisory by contract). --force bypasses upstream as with every close precheck; unreadable tickets silently pass (other guards own that).
- SCOPE decision: the guard scans the AC item's own text/continuation lines, NOT ticket comments — every real ticket's progress comments cite repo paths, so comment-scanning would false-positive universally.
- Updated 3 lifecycle tests that pinned the face-value exemption (they now carry valid provenance lines); doc section added to docs/plan-review-gate.md.

Evidence: RED first (mistagged + missing-provenance fixtures reached the billable verifier on clean HEAD), then GREEN. 29 new tests across tests/unit/test_det_attestation_launder.py, tests/unit/test_attested_close_guard.py, tests/interfaces/lifecycle/test_attested_close_guard_e2e.py. Mutation pass: 12/12 mutants killed (invert tag detection, skip URL scrub, drop each matcher, whole-section scan, containment filter, skip either check, unwire precheck, boundary errors). make lint + typecheck + complexity ratchet clean; lifecycle suite 591 passed; close/precheck/attest unit slice 569 passed.
